entry.title: BILL042(26) (Honolulu): PUBLISH → ZON
entry.content:
TO AMEND A PORTION OF THE STATE LAND USE DISTRICT BOUNDARY MAP (KAHUKU QUADRANGLE) FROM THE AGRICULTURAL DISTRICT TO THE URBAN DISTRICT FOR CERTAIN LANDS SITUATED IN THE KOʻOLAU LOA DEVELOPMENT PLAN AREA, LĀ‘IE, OʻAHU, HAWAIʻI.

Reclassifies certain lands in Lāʻie, Oʻahu from the State Land Use Agricultural District to the State Land Use Urban District.

Status: PUBLISH → ZON

Latest action: CR-250(26) Reported out for passage on second reading and scheduling of a public hearing as amended in CD1 form.
